title: AI characters in Unreal Engine that can act and react based on spoken commands
author: Western_Bug_5085
selftext:
We loved the response to our Actions reel, so here’s the full tutorial: enabling Actions, navigation setup, and object references, all in under five minutes.  
  
With Convai Actions, your Metahuman avatar can understand its environment, navigate the scene, interact with objects, and act on plain spoken commands.

Coming next: Parameterized Actions, where characters can pull objects and values out of natural language, and Dynamic Context, where live game state feeds the character’s awareness in real time.

**YT has all the links:** [https://youtu.be/yWqJQRttoEI](https://youtu.be/yWqJQRttoEI)

Let us know your thoughts and share any feedback below!
